Basic Requirement for IT SPECIALIST (INFOSEC): Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes: monitoring network operations to prevent unauthorized access to systems, networks, and data; and conducting security vulnerability testing of installed systems to identify system vulnerabilities; and determining hardware and software compliance with security configurations.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-09).

The specialized experience must include, or be supplemented by, information technology related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training, as appropriate) which demonstrates each of the four competencies, as defined: (1) Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: completing thorough and accurate work independently, even in the most difficult or stressful situations; occasionally reviewing work completed by others.

(2) Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: resolving routine and non-routine problems, questions, or complaints; developing and maintaining strong, mutually supportive working relationships with customers; conducting evaluation of support to determine quality of services and customer satisfaction, and recommending procedural changes based on customer need or changes in policy and/or regulation.

(3) Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: convincingly conveying complex information to customers; presenting thoughts that are well-organized and demonstrating confidence in the facts and ideas; adjusting style when working with individuals with different levels of understanding; using various methods to explain and convey information.

(4) Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: solving complex or sensitive problems by developing and proposing strategic alternatives; identifying possible conflicts and shared benefits; helping team anticipate problems and identifying and evaluating potential sources of information; providing feedback and coaching to others to help solve problems; engaging appropriate stakeholders when developing solutions in order to understand and incorporate multiple perspectives and needs; evaluating the effectiveness of decisions and adjusting future decisions as appropriate.

OR Education: Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree from an accredited or pre-accredited institution in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management; or, three full years of graduate education from an accredited or pre-accredited institution that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more of the fields identified above and required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks.

Experienced IT support professional. We're looking for 2+ years of direct hands-on experience delivering IT support in a corporate environment, including hands-on Okta administration. Experience supporting macOS is a strong plus.

En optant pour API, vous choisissez une entreprise à taille humaine bénéficiant d'un solide savoir-faire en informatique. Nous sommes fiers de notre culture d-entreprise unique car nous offertons des opportunités de développement professionnel, avec des programmes de formation continue, d'évolution de carrière ainsi qu-un suivi rigoureux.
Nous mettons l-humain au cœur de nos activités : après tout, nos ordinateurs peuvent résoudre des problèmes, mais ils ne savent toujours pas faire un bon café !
**Technicien support informatique**
Aujourd'hui, nous recherchons un Technicien Support Helpdesk N1-N2 pour rejoindre l'équipe de notre client à Neuchatel.

* Assurer le support technique de niveaux 1 et 2 auprès des étudiants et des collaborateurs de l'institution.
* Participer activement aux tournus de support (hotline, guichet d'accueil physique et gestion du système de tickets).
* Installer, configurer, maintenir et réparer le matériel informatique (PC, imprimantes, équipements audio/vidéo) ainsi que les logiciels.
* Analyser les pannes, participer au suivi des incidents et intervenir sur les différents sites de l'institution lors des tournées de support.
* Rédiger et maintenir à jour les procédures et la documentation technique du service.

* Formation professionnelle initiale achevée (CFC en informatique ou titre jugé équivalent).
* 3 à 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle confirmée dans le support informatique (Helpdesk, support de proximité).
* Excellente maîtrise des environnements Windows 11 et de la suite Microsoft 365 (M365).
* Bonnes notions des bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion des incidents (bonnes connaissances des processus ITIL).
* Maîtrise courante du français à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
* Excellentes capacités relationnelles, sens de l'écoute et de la diplomatie avec les utilisateurs.
* Esprit d'équipe tout en faisant preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur, de fiabilité et de discrétion.

s.h: Les étapes du processus de recrutement chez API
s.t:
* Engageons la conversation ! Pour commencer, nous souhaitons découvrir qui vous êtes : votre parcours, vos intérêts et vos aspirations. Cette première prise de contact nous permettra de mieux vous connaître.
* Approfondissons ! Vous aurez l-occasion de rencontrer nos Business Managers qui vous parleront de la vie de consultant chez API. Ce sera le moment idéal pour découvrir les projets qui retiennent votre attention en fonction de vos ambitions !
* Concrétisons ! Une fois l-adéquation entre vos ambitions, vos compétences et le projet établie, l-aventure ensemble peut commencer !

As a Supervisory IT Specialist (Risk Management Branch Chief), GS-2210-15, your typical work assignments may include: Acquire and manage the necessary resources, including leadership support, financial resources, and key security personnel, to support information technology (IT) security goals and objectives and reduce overall organizational risk.

Manages, directs, and coordinates a program that identifies Federal IT security requirements and develops the strategies that counter evolving threats in a rapidly changing global environment.

Establishes and evaluates procedures and methods for determining risk, vulnerabilities, and possible criticism of program operations, performance, and work processes to senior leadership.

Analyzes, evaluates, and verifies security profiles for Federal agency computer systems, networks, worldwide Information Systems (IS) and telecommunication systems to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of critical government information.

Demonstrates knowledge of advancements in technology and changes to related security policy and prepares detailed program briefings addressing problems and recommended courses of action.

Serve as a technical advisor to the Chief/Deputy Chief Information Security Officer on program effectiveness, efficiency, policy, and directs the evaluation of IT methods and practices to ensure best value to the government.

## Your Purpose ##
The IT Specialist - Inventory and Operations role is responsible for the effective management of IT assets, procurement, inventory and logistics to ensure the availability and compliance of technology resources across the organisation.

This position oversees the full lifecycle of IT equipment-from purchase order management and asset tracking through to deployment, maintenance and disposal, ensuring accurate inventory records and adherence to company procurement and financial policies.

The role also coordinates the shipment and delivery of IT assets, conducts inventory audits, manages stock levels to support operational readiness and provides reporting and forecasting to support budget planning.

· **Purchase Order (PO) Management:** Track the status of purchase orders for IT equipment, materials, and software in line with organizational budgets and approval processes.
· **Asset Lifecycle Management:** Manage IT assets from item coding through deployment, maintenance, and end-of-life disposal.
· **Shipping & Logistics Coordination:** Coordinate the shipment of IT assets, including (but not limited to) radios, satellite phones, laptops, mobile devices, network equipment, and peripherals. Monitor shipment status, delivery schedules, and receipt of equipment on board, ensuring all deliveries are accurately recorded and tracked.
· ** Inventory Control & Tracking:** Maintain accurate records of all IT assets within the Asset Management System (AMS), ensuring inventory accuracy, traceability, and up-to-date asset registers.
· **Inventory Audits & Spot Checks:** Conduct regular spot checks of IT equipment on board and perform periodic inventory audits to verify asset records, investigate discrepancies, and ensure compliance with asset management procedures.
· **Stock Management:** Monitor stock levels of IT equipment and consumables, maintain agreed par levels, review inventory requirements, and coordinate replenishment to ensure operational readiness.
· ** Procurement Compliance:** Ensure all purchases and asset movements comply with company financial policies, procurement procedures, and audit requirements.
· **Reporting & Forecasting:** Produce reports on asset condition, inventory levels, purchasing expenditure, and stock usage to support budget planning and forecasting.
· ** Quality Management System (QMS):** Support and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) by creating, updating, and controlling quality documentation, including forms, templates, procedures, work instructions, and records.

Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand your business. We fix that.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?
Notre solution est l'outil de travail principal de nos cabinets comptables, partenaires et dirigeants. La qualité du travail de ces utilisateurs dépend donc grandement de la qualité de notre solution.
En qualité d’expert du support technique, tu es garant de la fiabilité et la bonne utilisation quotidienne de la plateforme Pennylane.
Tu es entre autres responsable des sujets les plus techniques, qui peuvent avoir un impact très important sur la satisfaction client et sur l'image de Pennylane.
Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?
Tu es à la fois un référent fonctionnel comptable et un point de contact clé entre nos utilisateurs, les équipes support, produit et les développeurs.
Grâce à ta double compétence comptable et technique, tu accompagnes l’analyse des problématiques rencontrées par les utilisateurs sur la plateforme, qu’elles soient liées à des sujets métiers, fonctionnels ou techniques.
Tu investigues les incidents remontés via les tickets, identifies leur origine, évalues leur criticité et coordonnes leur résolution avec les équipes concernées. Tu assures également un suivi clair et régulier auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
Le poste demande autant de rigueur analytique que de communication : tu échanges quotidiennement avec plusieurs équipes internes et contribues directement à l’amélioration continue du produit et de l’expérience utilisateur.

Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, équipes produit, support et opérations pour assurer une résolution rapide et durable des problèmes identifiés.

Être capable d’investiguer des problématiques techniques simples via les outils mis à disposition (API, logs, Postman, SQL basique), comprendre les échanges techniques avec les développeurs et faciliter la communication entre équipes métier et tech.

Identifier les problématiques récurrentes, remonter les tendances observées et participer activement à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process internes.
Entraide & partage de connaissances
Participer à la montée en compétence des membres de l’équipe, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer à une culture collaborative et orientée résolution.

About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We’re looking for an experienced Database Support Engineer to join our Support Team and help developers unblock complex issues, build more reliably, and get the most out of the Supabase platform. You’ll work closely with customers and engineering, helping us improve product quality and developer experience based on real-world usage.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.
What You’ll Be Responsible For

Investigate and resolve advanced customer issues across Postgres, Auth, RLS, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, and client libraries.
Provide consultative, proactive advice to optimize workloads, avoid common pitfalls, and offer tailored advice to our most advanced users.
Reproduce bugs , isolate root causes, propose workarounds, and escalate to engineering with solid reproduction steps.
Ask smart, targeted questions that turn incomplete reports into actionable cases.
Communicate clearly and empathetically with users of all levels—especially during high-impact or time-sensitive situations.
Spot patterns across tickets and recommend improvements to documentation, tooling, and the product itself.
Mentor junior team members and help raise the overall bar for support quality.
You Might Be a Good Fit If
Experience: You have 7+ years in technical support, databases, backend engineering, SRE, or a similar field.
Postgres Expertise: You know PostgreSQL deeply—autovacuum behavior, WAL growth, long-running transactions, table bloat, and other internals.
Performance: You’re strong in high-performance SQL and query optimization.
